tldr: The Moon in Taurus: emotions seek steadiness, comfort, and embodied security.
body: With the Moon in Taurus, feelings settle through consistency, touch, beauty, food, nature, and routines that make the body believe life is safe. The Moon is exalted here, so emotional grounding can become a real strength.
gift: Calm presence, loyalty, patience, and the ability to regulate through simple, tangible care.
challenge: Stubbornness, emotional inertia, and clinging to comfort after it has stopped nourishing you.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
